prompt_template: You are annotating handwriting geometry, NOT transcribing or correcting it. Detect every visible PUPIL-HANDWRITTEN text line and every handwritten word on this notebook image. Ignore squared-paper ruling, printed notebook elements, red margin rules, drawings, and wholly blank areas. If non-pupil teacher handwriting is visibly distinguishable, exclude it and record its box/reason. Return ONLY one compact JSON object, no markdown, with schema: {"page":PAGE_NUMBER,"coordinate_space":{"width":1000,"height":1000},"lines":[{"id":"L001","box":[x0,y0,x1,y1],"words":[{"id":"L001W001","box":[x0,y0,x1,y1]}]}],"excluded_visible_handwriting":[{"box":[x0,y0,x1,y1],"reason":"..."}]}. Coordinates are integers normalized independently to the full image width/height (0..1000), boxes are tight, non-overlapping within a line where possible, every word box is inside its line box, and IDs follow visual reading order. Do not guess any text; output geometry only. PAGE_NUMBER is supplied separately per invocation.

protocol.primary_metrics: detected line count vs canonical scored-line count; detected word count vs canonical whitespace-token count; output-schema validity
protocol.secondary_metric: Luna/ReadingPipeline box agreement at greedy IoU >= 0.25
protocol.visual_review: dual-color overlays inspected at readable resolution
protocol.limitation: Counts are not precision/recall and transcript whitespace is only a proxy for word segmentation.

excluded_visible_handwriting.reason: Red handwritten grading or correction mark, not pupil text.

visual_findings: Pages 1 and 4 have essentially the same line coverage.
Luna finds several real lines missed by ReadingPipeline on page 5.
Luna emits two line boxes extending below the image on page 2 and one empty line-sized box; its raw output is not safe to consume without validation.
On page 3 Luna classifies two turquoise pupil-written lines as non-pupil annotations; ReadingPipeline detects more of that page.
Word segmentation is mixed: Luna is closer in aggregate token count, but ReadingPipeline has lower summed per-page count error.
summary.reason: Luna has a tiny line-count edge (absolute error 9 vs 10) but worse per-page word-count error and 16 geometry/schema violations. The five-page sample does not establish reliable overall outperformance.
